The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Large, dark brown to black necrotic lesions at the leaf margins/tips
- Yellow/tan halos surrounding the dark areas
- Irregular lesion shape, no concentric rings
- Otherwise green leaf tissue

This pattern strongly suggests Late Blight (large irregular dark lesions with yellow halos at margins). Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference Late Blight image shows large dark brown necrotic lesions spreading across the leaf, consistent with the test image pattern. The test image shows:
- Large dark brown/black necrotic patches at leaf margins
- Yellow halos around lesions
- No concentric ring pattern (rules out Early Blight)
- Irregular lesion shape typical of Phytophthora late blight
